notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
samrdump.py (Impacket) queries the SAMR (Security Account Manager Remote) protocol to enumerate domain users, groups, and password policy via null session or credentials. Automates what rpcclient does manually.

=== CHAINING ===
samrdump → user list → password policy → plan spray attack → use enum4linux-ng if samrdump misses data (tool implementations differ, complement each other).

=== vs RPCCLIENT ===
samrdump.py outputs clean structured data automatically. rpcclient requires manual command entry. Both use SAMR protocol. Use both — one may return results the other misses due to implementation differences.
